paragraphs.source_en: “That is one of the men who was watching us!” At the sight of the newcomer, Sōkei straightened in astonishment.

paragraphs.source_en: “There is no cause for concern. Those two or three men you saw were sent by me.” Having said this, Shōan addressed the robust man of twenty-four or twenty-five who had just entered. “This is Master Chaya from the capital.”

paragraphs.source_en: “An honor to meet you.”

units.source_en: “An honor to meet you.”

paragraphs.source_en: “As you command.”

units.source_zh: “遵命。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “遵命。”

paragraphs.source_en: Upon hearing Shōan's arrangements, Chaya Shirōjirō sat stunned for a long while.

units.source_en: Upon hearing Shōan's arrangements, Chaya Shirōjirō sat stunned for a long while.
units.source_zh: 听了蕉庵这番安排，茶屋四郎次郎不觉呆了好大工夫。

paragraphs.source_en: “Master Chaya, I must entrust this to you.”

units.source_zh: “茶屋先生，有劳你了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “I… understand everything now.”

paragraphs.source_en: “Okin, take good care of yourself.”
